---
title: "NY NOAA Weather, 2003. I was born then."
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
---

###Flexdashboard...kinda unrelated to my website

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)
library(flexdashboard)

data("ny_noaa")

ny_noaa

noaa =
  ny_noaa |>
  separate(date, into = c("year", "month", "day"), sep = "-") |>
  filter(year == "2003") |>
  mutate(
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin) / 10)
```

Column {data-width=650}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Daily max vs. min temperature (°C) for each month (Scatterplot)

```{r}
noaa |>
  drop_na(tmax, tmin) |>
  mutate(text_label = str_c("Station: ", id, "\nMonth: ", month)) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~tmin, y = ~tmax, type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
    color = ~month, text = ~text_label, alpha = 0.5, colors = "viridis")
```

Column {data-width=350}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Days when it rained each month (Bar Chart)

```{r}
noaa |>
  filter(prcp > 0) |>
  count(month) |>
  plot_ly(x = ~month, y = ~n, color = ~month, type = "bar", colors = "viridis")
```
### Daily low temp for each month (Box plot)

```{r}
noaa |>
  drop_na(tmin) |>
  plot_ly(x = ~month, y = ~tmin, color = ~month, type = "box", colors = "viridis")
```
